edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller of openPacks, the source of safeTransferFrom and the mint recipient with no access restriction.
msg.sender determines the fee waiver and the burned/minted cards in swapCards.
msg.sender is part of the pseudo random seed in random().
withdraw_all is gated by onlyClevel which compares msg.sender to walletA, walletB or owner.
setNFTAddress is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSwapFee is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setWalletBPercentage is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setWalletA requires msg.sender to equal the current walletA.
setWalletB requires msg.sender to equal the current walletB.
The NFT balance query uses msg.sender as the queried account.
block.timestamp is used as the randomness seed, making the draw miner manipulable.
random() depends on block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
The nonce state variable is mixed into the keccak256 randomness seed.
nonce is read into the seed of the weak randomness computation.
random() increments the nonce after each draw.
nonce++ is an unchecked increment of a uint256 state variable.
openPacks calls random() to derive founder card ids.
The weak random result determines the minted founder card id.
_range bounds the modulo used to derive the random value.
random() computes and returns the rnd local value.
packContract is the arbitrary token address targeted by safeTransferFrom.
packContract is compared against founderPackAddress inside openPacks.
_amount is passed as the token amount to safeTransferFrom.
_amount is validated and drives the whole openPacks flow.
amountBaseCards is computed as _amount multiplied by cardsPerNormalPack.
cardsPerNormalPack is the multiplier applied to the number of opened packs.
amountFounderCards equals _amount when the founder pack is opened.
founderPackAddress is used to decide whether founder cards are granted.
activeDeck is forwarded to the external card dealer call.
activeDeck is forwarded to the external card dealer call in swapCards.
cardDealer is the external contract invoked by openPacks.
cardDealer is the external contract invoked by swapCards.
The external randomCards call returns the baseCards array.
openPacks performs an external call to cardDealer before mutating balances, allowing callback into the caller controlled contract.
baseCards are minted to msg.sender inside the loop.

Loop counter f controls the founder card mint loop.
openPacks executes the mint loops and updates lastUnpackedByAddress.
_mint triggers the ERC1155 acceptance check on the recipient, an external callback after state changes.
The founder card id is minted inside the loop.
openPacks records the unpacked card ids in lastUnpackedByAddress.

The external randomCards call returns newCards.

The fee requirement gates the rest of swapCards.
newCards are minted to the caller in the swap loop.
swapCards runs the burn then mint loop.
swapCards overwrites lastUnpackedByAddress with the newly drawn cards.

walletBPercentage is multiplied into the amountB computation.
amountB is computed with div and mul over the contract balance.
amountA is computed by subtracting amountB from the balance.
